newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA THREATENS URUGUAY WITH SANCTIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA THREATENS URUGUAY WITH SANCTIONS.

text.p: The Uruguay Football Association has been threatened with severe sanctions after seven players were booked in a match against Chile, FIFA, world soccer's governing body said on Tuesday.
FIFA's disciplinary committee informed the Uruguay association in a letter that any re-occurence of the rough play seen in the World Cup qualifying match last Tuesday would attract sanctions.
Contrary to reports, FIFA did not stipulate what form the sanctions might take.
Carlos Maresca, president of the UFA, said in a letter: "We had a meeting with the players pointing out our concerns. We will take into account such behaviour in future nominations to the squad."
